channel.description: Posts in the forum category "Introductions" - New to the site? Introduce yourself and meet other site members here.

item.title: DECEMBER 2020 INTROS - Writers: Re: DECEMBER 2020 INTROS - Writers
item.content:encoded: Hello everyone! I’m Gibbs. I joined this site so I could maybe practice writing a few fiction stories in order to get the hang of it. Hopefully I can improve upon my writings through the plethora of mistakes I will inevitably make and perhaps even interact with the community as a whole some time. God bless you all and good luck in 2021!

item.title: DECEMBER 2020 INTROS - Writers: Re: DECEMBER 2020 INTROS - Writers
item.content:encoded: Greetings fellow people! I'm gonna admit right off the bat that I'm amateur when it comes to writing but I'll try my best! I get a lot of inspiration from amazing SCP articles and I feel like I need to get my creative throws out onto a page. Enough about all that though, it's a pleasure to meet you all and I can't wait to get started!!

item.title: DECEMBER 2020 INTROS - Writers: Re: DECEMBER 2020 INTROS - Writers
item.content:encoded: Hey all, I used to be an avid reader of SCPs about 5 years ago until life got in the way. I have been a huge fan of the site since. I recently dove back into reading SCPs, and I have a few half-baked ideas that I hope will stick. Even if they don't, I've had fun going through them in my head.

item.title: DECEMBER 2020 INTROS - Readers & Reviewers: Re: DECEMBER 2020 INTROS - Readers & Reviewers
item.content:encoded:
Hello everyone, I'm Shishiza man.
I have already participated in SCP-JP, and although I will write my original article there, I participated in SCP-EN to vote for articles that have not yet been translated into Japanese. And in the future, I also want to write articles in English.
I'm studying English and I can't speak perfect English yet, but I'll do my best. Nice to meet you.

For the monthly question: Given what I want to create, I have a hard time falling asleep. Sometimes I write original fantasy stories that aren't related to SCP, but when I think about what to write it next, I'm having fun and sleepless.

item.content:encoded:
hello everyone!

i've been a fan of the foundation since around 2013-ish, but it's only now that i've joined the wiki. I have several concepts, though I haven't actually written any of them yet. I'm incredibly happy to be a part of this whole thing!

item.title: DECEMBER 2020 INTROS - Readers & Reviewers: Re: DECEMBER 2020 INTROS - Readers & Reviewers
item.content:encoded:
Hello! I'm usually that quiet guy who just sits back and reads, but since introduction seems to be a tradition here, I won't break it.
I've been a regular reader on this wiki for around 5 years now, and I just had this idea of "why not make an account" recently, so here I am. My favorites are definetly the reality-bending and mind-affecting SCPs.
About the question, either random stuff like making up a story or the embarassing things I did years ago, or giving myself a good existential crisis.

item.title: DECEMBER 2020 INTROS - Writers: Re: DECEMBER 2020 INTROS - Writers
item.content:encoded:
Hey everyone!

I've always loved the SCP franchise, and recently, I've taken a more major interest in it. I really enjoy reading the amazingly well-written SCPs and the tales that often go along with them. I chose to create my introduction in the "writers" thread since I plan on authoring my own SCPs, but I'm really planning on being a jack-of-all-trades and reading/reviewing other articles, too. Any tips, suggestions, and/or general comments are welcome!

Happy to finally be apart of the site!

item.title: DECEMBER 2020 INTROS - Writers: Re: DECEMBER 2020 INTROS - Writers
item.content:encoded: Hey everyone thanks for letting me be apart of this community!. I am really excited to learn more about the SCP community. I just recently found out about it and really liked the professionalism the site takes to get good articles on the wiki. I first heard about SCPs from watching Youtube videos and it peaked my interest. One thing that keeps me up at night is wanting to find new hobbies that excite me. This is the first hobby in awhile that I got really excited to dive in and try. I want to be a writer on this site and I have so many ideas for new SCPs I cant wait to get started!

item.title: DECEMBER 2020 INTROS - Writers: Re: DECEMBER 2020 INTROS - Writers
item.content:encoded:
Hey Alias Copernicus, and welcome! You'd be surprised just how many people join the site like yourself. They spend a long time reading from it but not joining till much later. But, we are glad you decided to join. Being a fan of mystery should be like a gold mine here, there are so many articles I've read that just leave me wondering. Make sure to take your time and get acquainted with how everything here works, and make sure to check out IRC chat too!

For my recommendation, you should check out SCP-5699

+ Resources
- Hide Resources

For posting ideas, make sure you go through the proper greenlighting process on the idea forums first. Remember that there is no rush, and you should take time familiarizing yourself with how Series 6 articles are formatted. We are a rather unique bunch so I'm sure just reading and being a part of the community will be rather fun for you!

If you're going to try your hand at writing, try out our sandbox. You can make yourself a page here to store your drafts.

Sandbox

For hashing out concepts, try out the Ideas and Brainstorming forum. You can run your ideas by the community if you need help refining your concept.

If you have a draft ready, make a thread in the Drafts and Critiques forum. Remember to check the stickied posts in the relevant thread for guidelines on how best to use each forum. You can also try the IRC chat for real-time feedback.

From site usage to writing tips, the Guide Hub contains a wealth of resources geared towards helping members produce successful articles.

The more time you take to familiarize yourself with the SCP style, the drafting process, and the community, the greater your chances are for success!

As far as reading is concerned, you might want to check out our Top Rated New Pages, which will display the most popular, recent articles. It's helpful to keep up with what's being received well by the community.


Best of luck!

item.title: DECEMBER 2020 INTROS - Writers: Re: DECEMBER 2020 INTROS - Writers
item.content:encoded:
Hello hello socialdeath! Welcome to the Wiki! I'm Ralliston, a site author and a member of the Community Outreach Team - with this helpful little comment, I'll try to help you find your way around the site and link a bunch of useful places and links that will help you in your SCP journey.

It's awesome to see you want to contribute to the site - I really can't wait to see what you'll come up with. If you'll want to look for helpful resources filled to the brim with content that is created to guide you through your writing journey, you'll want to click that little red collapsible at the bottom of this comment - there, you'll find a plethora of useful resources created for the purpose of guiding new members of the site towards guides and other resources which will definitely help you improve your writing and seek help on it.

Without further ado though, let's click the collapsible, shall we? :)

+ show block
– hide block

If you're going to try your hand at writing, try out our Sandbox. You can make yourself a page here to store your drafts, which are in-works articles. Using it, you can link the drafts to reviewers to get their opinions on them before posting. It really helps everyone out a lot.

For brainstorming concepts, try out the Ideas and Brainstorming forum. You can run your ideas by experienced members of the community if you need help refining and fleshing out your concept. It's a very helpful little place for when you want to start your writing journey, especially when you're not sure if the idea is all that great.

If you have a draft ready, make a thread in the Drafts and Critiques forum. Remember to check the stickied posts in the relevant thread for guidelines on how best to use each forum. You can also try the IRC chat for real-time feedback.

From site usage to writing tips, the Guide Hub contains a wealth of resources geared towards helping members produce successful articles. Within the Guides, you will find useful information written by experienced members of the site for the use of newer ones.

The more time you take to familiarize yourself with the SCP style, the drafting process, and the community, the greater your chances are for success! Remember - there is no rush to writing - take your time! The more time you spend on fleshing your ideas out, the more your chance of success becomes!

As far as reading is concerned, you might want to check out Top Rated New Pages, which will display the most popular recent articles. It's helpful to keep up with what's being received well by the community to implement into your very own writing. Alternatively, you might want to look at the User Curated Lists page, where members of the community list and rank their favorite articles in different genres and themes, showing which attempts at such are successful and what the community likes.

Best of luck with your future contributions to the site! I hope you enjoy your time here as much as we do! If you have any more questions, feel free to message me here on Wikidot or on the IRC chats!

item.title: DECEMBER 2020 INTROS - Writers: Re: DECEMBER 2020 INTROS - Writers
item.content:encoded: Hello, I have learned about the SCP foundation in a YouTube Video 3 years ago. Since then I have started to research more and more about the foundation and played several SCP related games. And then I have started watching videos about individual SCPs and got the Idea that I should maybe write an SCP on my own. So I have started to make a concept for an SCP. Meanwhile I have joined the foundation and am planning to finish my SCP soon.

item.title: DECEMBER 2020 INTROS - Writers: Re: DECEMBER 2020 INTROS - Writers
item.content:encoded: Hiya, I go by Hypastryx! I joined the site because I utterly love creative writing (Have been doing so for 6 years now) and SCP as a concept in and of itself always fascinated me. I *hope* as opposed to plan, to create one or more SCPs that are an interesting read, while also providing a more psychological side to the creatures/humanoids themselves that I create. I also love the atmosphere provided by a community with a set up like this, and even if my first ones divebomb I'm just thrilled to be here!

item.title: DECEMBER 2020 INTROS - Readers & Reviewers: Re: DECEMBER 2020 INTROS - Readers & Reviewers
item.content:encoded:
So, yes, hello, I'm Nova. I joined the site through… the internet, basically. I just started looking up SCPs once I found out what they were. I don't exactly know what I want to do on here, I'm still try to figure that out, so I'll get back to you guys on that.

Some hobbies I have are: drawing, singing, making YouTube videos(when I have the time) and baking. Though, as of right now, I mainly just draw.

Anyways, that's all from me for now. I am happy to be here and happy to meet people.
